package rulefixtures

import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"net/http"
)

// scenario for db_ping_per_request: database Ping(...) or PingContext(...) called on request paths instead of startup or explicit health checks.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: data_access; severity: contextual.
type Rule254PositiveRecord struct {
	db *sql.DB
}

func scenario254Positive(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, repo Rule254PositiveRecord) {
	ctx := r.Context()

	if err := repo.db.PingContext(ctx); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "database not available", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		return
	}

	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
}
